text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan still hasn't arrived for our
training
session. Just when I start to
think she might not
show up at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I apologize for the
inconvenience to
which I've subjected
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry. There's simply no excuse
for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I've discovered a cookbook
titled
"Cooking for Health," and it's
been incredibly
enlightening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Its recipes have vastly improved my
condition,
but I found myself so
wrapped up in cooking that
I lost track
of time... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan does seem to be reflecting
on her
actions, so I let her off with a
light warning.
